definitions.ask: Should a sized close chain only at the front of its line, so text after a close or start keeps its meaning?
definitions.why: After a close or start a sized close can never succeed, so claiming it only breaks log text

choices.label: `x 2x faster` logs `2x faster`; `--1 2x!2` and `2x =` still chain
`2x` chains wherever `x` does but never heads a trail; `x 2x faster` fails

definitions.ask: Should the docs phase add a decisions record for the sized close's exact-or-refuse rule?
